Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu
Before running any of the following code, set the experiment name in line 18. This should be the name of the folder that the key (.csv file) and monitor (.txt) files are located.
Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
```
Set Experiment name
```{r,define experiment}
# Define the active experiment name
experiment_name <- "DAM0"
```
Load in data and aggregate the activity counts by minute, save to "output" folder.
```{r,counts by minute}
# Source the aggregate counts R script
source("scripts/aggregate_count_data.R")
# Call the function from the external script with the experiment name
result <- aggregate_counts(paste("data/", experiment_name, sep = ""), aggregation_level = "minute")
# Specify the metadata file name using the experiment name
metadata_file <- paste("data/", experiment_name, "/key.csv", sep = "")
# Load the metadata and combine with the aggregate data
metadata_df <- read.csv(metadata_file)
merged_df <- merge(result, metadata_df, by = c("Tube", "Monitor"), all.x = FALSE)
# Filter rows based on the "Notes" column, removing questionable data
activity_minutes <- merged_df[!grepl("injured|dead|offspring|malformed", merged_df$Notes, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
# Separate Minute into Date and Time
activity_minutes <- activity_minutes %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Minute),
         Time = format(Minute, "%H:%M:%S"))
# Format dateEclosed
activity_minutes$dateEclosed <- mdy(activity_minutes$dateEclosed)
# Calculate AgeD (difference in days between dateEclosed and Date)
activity_minutes <- activity_minutes %>%
  mutate(AgeD = as.numeric(difftime(Date, dateEclosed, units = "days")))
# Add the experiment name as the first column
activity_minutes <- activity_minutes %>%
  mutate(Experiment = experiment_name)
# Reorder columns with Experiment as the first column
activity_minutes <- activity_minutes %>%
  dplyr::select(Experiment, everything())
# Specify the output file name using the experiment name
output_file <- paste("output/", experiment_name, "_minute.csv", sep = "")
# Save the filtered and aggregated data to a CSV file
write.csv(activity_minutes, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
Calculate sleeping time, on a rolling period can be adjusted in minutes_window. The default if you do not change it is 3 minutes. Sleep is defined as no activity for 5 or more minutes.
```{r,sleep rolling average}
# Source the sleep bouts R script
source("scripts/rolling_sleep_average.R")
#Calculate rolling average of inactive or "sleeping" time
sleep_minutes <- calculate_rolling_average(activity_minutes, minutes_window = 3)#This is where you change the rolling period, if desired
# Add the experiment name as the first column
sleep_minutes <- sleep_minutes %>%
  mutate(Experiment = experiment_name)
# Reorder columns with Experiment as the first column
sleep_minutes <- sleep_minutes %>%
  dplyr::select(Experiment, everything())
# Specify the output file name using the experiment name
output_file <- paste("output/", experiment_name, "_sleep.csv", sep = "")
# Save the filtered and aggregated data to a CSV file
write.csv(sleep_minutes, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
Load in data and aggregate the counts by hour, save to "output" folder
```{r,counts by hour}
# Source the aggregate counts R script
source("scripts/aggregate_count_data.R")
# Call the function from the external script with the experiment name
result <- aggregate_counts(paste("data/", experiment_name, sep = ""), aggregation_level = "hour")
# Specify the metadata file name using the experiment name
metadata_file <- paste("data/", experiment_name, "/key.csv", sep = "")
# Load the metadata and combine with the aggregate data
metadata_df <- read.csv(metadata_file)
merged_df <- merge(result, metadata_df, by = c("Tube", "Monitor"), all.x = FALSE)
# Filter rows based on the "Notes" column, removing questionable data
activity_hours <- merged_df[!grepl("injured|dead|offspring|malformed", merged_df$Notes, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
# Separate Hour into Date and Time
activity_hours <- activity_hours %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Hour),
         Time = format(Hour, "%H:%M:%S"))
# Format dateEclosed
activity_hours$dateEclosed <- mdy(activity_hours$dateEclosed)
# Calculate AgeD (difference in days between dateEclosed and Date)
activity_hours <- activity_hours %>%
  mutate(AgeD = as.numeric(difftime(Date, dateEclosed, units = "days")))
# Add the experiment name as the first column
activity_hours <- activity_hours %>%
  mutate(Experiment = experiment_name)
# Reorder columns with Experiment as the first column
activity_hours <- activity_hours %>%
  dplyr::select(Experiment, everything())
# Specify the output file name using the experiment name
output_file <- paste("output/", experiment_name, "_hour.csv", sep = "")
# Save the filtered and aggregated data to a CSV file
write.csv(activity_hours, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
